messages:
lina: Heads-up: I'm putting together a sampling + signal list for the per-route KPI card in Console (p50/p95/p99, token waterfall, TPS, error%). Need perf/runtime/metrics input on kernel & KV signals and a sampling plan that won't bias cache-heavy routes. Short thread please.

samir: How big are we thinking for raw telemetry retention? token-level waterfalls explode if we keep everything.

miriam: We should capture kernel_tag and batch_size histograms + a kv_hit boolean per request. kv_hit skew will make p99s look much better for cached routes.

devon: Agree. For storage: keep raw token waterfall samples for a 6h sliding window, keep aggregated percentiles for 30d. Pre-aggregate by route+model+kernel_tag to cut cardinality.

arjun: Also important to correlate rollouts — include rollout_id and model_variant so we can slice p99 by rollout.

lina: Proposed sampling: 1% full token stacks for all routes + 100% for routes with error_rate>0.5% OR tps>200. That keeps signal on hot/erroring routes while bounding storage. Thoughts?

samir: 1% is ok for most, but KV cache bias remains. Suggest stratified sampling by kv_hit: 0.5% for kv_hit=true, 5% for kv_hit=false. That preserves tail signal for uncached requests.

miriam: Strong +1. Also track kernel_choice (reason) when runtime selects an alternate kernel: values like 'best_kernel', 'quant_fallback', 'cpu_fallback'.

devon: Metric naming proposal for dashboards/alerts:
- route.p50_latency_ms
- route.p95_latency_ms
- route.p99_latency_ms
- route.token_throughput (tokens/sec)
- route.error_rate (errs/req)
- route.kv_hit_rate
- route.batch_size_p50, route.batch_size_p95
We'll also persist token_waterfall samples to object store and reference them by tw_sample_id in events.

lina: Example OLAP query for p95 by kernel (clickhouse style):
```
SELECT route, quantileExact(0.95)(token_latency_ms) AS p95
FROM token_waterfalls
WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
  AND kernel_tag = 'cuda_f16'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY p95 DESC
LIMIT 50
```

arjun: Can we add a kernel_choice tag with the fallback reason? That will help root-cause p99 regressions vs kernel changes.

lina: Will add kernel_choice. ops-bot: please remind infra to rotate retention policy at month end.

ops-bot: @lina reminder set: create retention-ticket for token-waterfalls; due in 7 days.

metrics-bot: Reminder: create dashboard PR + retention ticket. /create-ticket #infra-retention

devon: :thumbsup: I'll draft the dashboard card layout. Proposal: top row p50/p95/p99 numeric + 24h sparkline + traffic heatmap. Middle row token waterfall sample viewer (pull tw_sample_id). Bottom row kv_hit_rate and kernel_breakdown pie + batch size histogram.

miriam: Also include a synthetic-eval route we run every hour. If route.p99 deviates >15% vs baseline, trigger regression eval and send to #perf-alerts.

samir: Good. Next steps:
- devon: PR metric names + mock data for UI
- lina: update sampling config (stratified by kv_hit)
- arjun: add rollout_id/model_variant tags to telemetry
- miriam: provide synthetic-eval route config and baseline numbers

lina: Thanks all. I'll open a draft PR in ~30m and ping @devon when it's up.

arjun: quick note — include batch_size at the token-level and also record request.start_seq_len to differentiate short prompts vs long contexts.

miriam: Also add a boolean 'kernel_stable' computed flag if kernel_choice == 'best_kernel' and no fallback in last 1h. Useful for filters.

lina: copying TODOs into the PR description. Closing the thread for now but will update with links. :)
